jobs.description:
TJX Companies
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:
Staff Product Manager – Oracle Retail (Merchandise Operations Management Team)

About the Team
The Merchandise Operations Management (MOM) Delivery team leads the modernization of our global merchandise financial systems, including pricing and clearance management. We implement off-the-shelf Oracle Retail solutions to support key finance processes and markdown strategies. These systems are critical to managing merchandise, ensuring accurate vendor payments, and delivering reliable financial data to Wall Street.
Our team of 70+ associates is globally distributed across India, Europe, and North America. This footprint enables a “follow-the-sun” delivery model and brings diverse perspectives and innovation to everything we do.

Role Overview
As a Staff Product Manager, you will work under the Product Manager within the planning function, driving forward our most complex business and IT modernization initiatives. You’ll collaborate with senior IT and business stakeholders to enable growth, deliver efficient and high-quality solutions, and ensure robust, scalable outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Solution Engineering to shape both functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring a steady flow of high-value work to our execution teams.
The focus in coming years will be driving the modernization of our US divisions, with roadmap activities in HGS, MMX and Sierra to replace legacy systems with our product suite.   We will also continue to provide business enablement and value-add capabilities in our existing divisions, and support to the Integrated Technology Roadmap and Mainframe decommissioning initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
- Partner with Product Management to understand customer needs, pain points, workflows, and priorities.
- Own epic decomposition into features and refine them to align with business needs and IT standards.
- Define test approaches for epics and features, identifying automation opportunities to improve efficiency.
- Collaborate with Solution Engineering to ensure solution designs meet business objectives.
- Oversee and validate high-quality non-functional requirements aligned with enterprise standards.
- Champion a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) mindset to reduce unnecessary work and promote global reuse.
- Proactively identify risks and dependencies that could impact epic or feature success.
- Engage early with support teams to ensure smooth adoption and service transition.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to manage dependencies and secure delivery commitments.

Minimum Qualifications
- Proven experience as a Product Owner/Manager or similar role.
- Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence.
- Strong communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
- Ability to document process flows and simplify complex topics for business audiences.
- Skilled in negotiation and influence.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Data-savvy with the ability to identify patterns and anomalies.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced environment managing multiple priorities.
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organizational and prioritization mindset.

Preferred Qualifications
- Functional knowledge of Oracle Retail applications (RMS Foundation, Stock Ledger, ReSA, ReIM, RPM) or deep understanding of TJX merchandise flow processes.
- Technical knowledge of Oracle Retail systems (RMS, RPM, ReIM, ReSA).
- Experience working within a SAFe Agile delivery model.
- SAFe Agile certifications are a plus.

Benefits include Associate discount; 401(k) match; medical/dental/vision; HSA; health care FSA; life insurance; short/long-term disability; paid holidays/vacation /sick/bereavement/parental leave; EAP; incentive programs for management; auto/home insurance discounts; tuition reimbursement; scholarship program; adoption/surrogacy assistance; smoking cessation; child care/cell phone discounts; pet/legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. All benefits are subject to applicable plan or program terms (including eligibility terms) and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. Job Description:
Manager of Product Management - Workday
Narrative
The TJX Companies, the leading off-price apparel and home fashions retailer in the U.S. and the world is looking for a Manager of Product Management to join our Human Capital Management (HCM) Solution Delivery team which is responsible for software and systems that support TJX’s world-class Global Human Resources and Payroll organizations.  This role will lead the team that designs, configures, and delivers the Global Workday Human Capital Management solution.
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced, Senior Product Manager who is passionate about all aspects of agile product management, is highly organized, and communicates well with internal and external stakeholders.  The Manager of Product Management will collaborate with a wide range of people, including Senior Management and Business Leaders to identify and define customer needs, understand the Solution Context, and develops the Program Vision, Roadmap, and Features required to meet these needs including assurance that business needs cascades down to the team level. This role requires close, ongoing partnership with Engineering and Delivery counterparts to align on technical and delivery considerations, planning, and execution, ensuring solutions are strategic, high quality, and delivered efficiently.
Key responsibilities include:
- Maintains a prioritized portfolio backlog, including the prioritization of epics with all global business partners
- Manages the overall solution design from a functional and technical perspective to minimize design/functionality conflicts
- Recognizes and manages upstream/downstream impacts from product decisions
- Manages design decisions that might impact other modules in scope
- Serves as the Platform SME across the modules in scope
- Coordinates across multiple Product Teams to manage dependencies
- Maintains overall responsibility for end-to-end testing - scenarios and execution
- Responsible for decisions that directly impact project timelines and budgets
- Manages demand versus capacity gaps and resource contention issues
- Partners with various teams within IT as needed to build agreements around solution approaches, operating principles, transition to production, etc. to deliver scalable, optimized solutions
- Ensures the program deliverables meet quality & success criteria following audit and controls guidelines.
- Creates strategies for risk mitigation and contingency planning at the portfolio/program level. Identifies and solves issues

Minimum Qualifications
- Overall experience required 16-22 years
- Team management experience required 6+ years
- 5+ years’ experience working on a large, global platform of Workday HCM
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think independently
- Exceptional listening and communication skills (written, verbal)
- Strong agile leadership and methodology experience (Portfolio SAFe preferred)
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent IT Delivery skillset/training/experience
- Experience in leading corporate initiatives that have successfully introduced new technology solutions

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's/Master’s Degree in information systems or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Deep knowledge of solution delivery lifecycle, including product management, business requirements, application development, testing, technologies/platforms, frameworks, and methodologies
- Workday certification preferred but not required
- Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe Product Manager (POPM) preferred

Job Description:
Job Title:   Staff Product Owner

Location:   Hyderabad, India

About TJX

TJX is a leading off-price retailer with a global technology organization that supports business growth across multiple geographies, including the U.S., Canada, Europe, Australia, and India. TJX India serves as an extension of the global IT organization and provides a platform for talent, innovation, capability, and capacity. The Hyderabad office brings together collaborative technology teams that partner across global business and technology functions to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions for the enterprise.

What you’ll discover

- Inclusive culture and career growth opportunities

- Global IT Organization which collaborates across U.S., Canada, Europe ,   Australia   and India , click   here   to learn   more.

- Challenging, collaborative, and team-based environment

Business Area / Tower Profile

The Platform Integration and Enablement organization delivers, operates, and continuously improves the foundational infrastructure platforms that enable TJX applications and enterprise services. PIE provides resilient, scalable, and secure capabilities across data centers, cloud environments, stores, and distribution centers, forming the core platform layer on which application teams build and run solutions.

Job Summary

As a Staff Product Owner in Infrastructure Enablement, you will define, prioritize, and drive delivery of infrastructure platform capabilities that enable high-performance application hosting across TJX. You will own a strategic, multi-team product backlog and ensure alignment with PIE strategy, PMO governance, and enterprise priorities. This role partners closely with engineering teams, PIE and PMO leadership, architecture, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to balance strategic roadmaps with operational needs, manage cross-domain dependencies, and deliver measurable business and technology outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Own and manage a strategic infrastructure product backlog across multiple teams, ensuring priorities are aligned to enterprise outcomes, PIE strategy, PMO governance, and operational needs.

- Translate business and technology objectives into clear features, user stories, enablers, acceptance criteria, and measurable delivery outcomes.

- Partner with engineering, architecture, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders to define roadmaps, manage dependencies, and drive delivery through sprint and PI cycles.

- Prioritize infrastructure investments based on reliability, scalability, resiliency, security, compliance, performance, cost, and business impact.

- Support infrastructure modernization initiatives including cloud adoption, platform migrations, data center transformation, patching, upgrades, and technology lifecycle management.

- Use operational metrics, KPIs, platform health data, and stakeholder feedback to inform prioritization, remove impediments, and improve platform value.

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product, platform, or delivery leadership role within infrastructure, platform engineering, or enterprise technology environments.

- Proven experience managing complex infrastructure or platform backlogs, translating strategic objectives into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

- Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and practices, including Scrum and SAFe, with experience using tools such as Jira, Jira Align, and Confluence.

- Experience defining, prioritizing, and refining user stories, features, and enablers with clear acceptance criteria and technical requirements.

- Strong understanding of infrastructure domains such as cloud platforms, compute, storage, databases, middleware, networking, and enterprise application hosting.

- Experience working in enterprise IT delivery environments, including governance, architecture review processes, security requirements, and structured operating models.

- Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies and coordinate delivery across infrastructure, engineering, security, operations, and vendor teams.

- Strong analytical, critical thinking, facilitation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

- Self-driven and adaptable professional with strong situational awareness and the ability to proactively identify risks, resolve impediments, and support informed decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

- Product Owner or Product Management certification, such as SAFe POPM or CSPO.

- Deep understanding of enterprise infrastructure domains, including cloud services, compute, storage, networking, middleware, databases, disaster recovery, and data center operations.

- Knowledge of infrastructure architecture principles, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, performance optimization, and operational readiness practices.

- Exposure to infrastructure financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, vendor management, and FinOps disciplines.

- Familiarity with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms.

- Experience partnering with Security and Risk teams to support vulnerability remediation, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and governance requirements.

- Strong understanding of operational service management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Configuration Management processes.

- Experience leveraging ServiceNow and infrastructure monitoring platforms to drive operational insights, service reliability, and platform health improvements.

Job Description:

We’re   looking for a   Senior Product Analyst   to join our agile Workday   Compensation   team and play a key role in designing secure, scalable, and audit ‑ ready solutions across our global Workday platform. This senior role offers the opportunity to work hands ‑ on with Workday configuration s , lead cross ‑ functional discovery sessions, and mentor junior analysts—while acting as a trusted SME guiding strategic product decisions.

You’ll   drive feature refinement, solution design, and end ‑ to ‑ end testing with autonomy, audit requirements, and regulatory needs. If   you're   passionate about Workday   Compensation   and want to influence meaningful change in a collaborative, fast ‑ paced environment, this is the role for you.

Why Work With Us?

- We value integrity, respect, and teamwork, encouraging a unique and inclusive culture.

- Enjoy Associate discounts at our stores, available to you and eligible family members

- Immediate access to our Group Benefits package, including a Health Care Spending Account, Retirement Savings Program, Associate & Family Assistance Program, and various well ‑ being resources.

- Comprehensive training and development resources designed to help you learn, grow, and succeed.

What You’ll Do:

- Collaborate with the   Compensation   team, other product teams, and business partners to   gather requirements , configure security settings, and support testing and audit activities .

- Coordinate   functional and non ‑ functional testing   (e.g., regression, negative testing,   SoD   validation) to ensure solutions meet policy, audit, and risk standards.

- Partner with audit, risk, and compliance teams on   access reviews, controls testing, remediation , and release readiness; maintain high ‑ quality   process   documentation.

- Mentor junior analysts and champion standards for configuration, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

Technical Expertise

Workday Configuration Expertise

- Deep hands-on experience configuring:

- Compensation packages, grades, plans, and eligibility rules

- Compensation plans (Merit, Bonus, Stock, Commission, One-time payments, Allowances)

- Advanced Compensation cycles and worksheets

- Strong understanding of:

- Compensation calculation frameworks and guideline logic

Business Process (BP) & Security Integration

- Hire, compensation change, bonus payout, stock grant, and off-cycle adjustments

- Workday Business Process Framework (BPF)
